PHONE_NUMBER.description: Your own WhatsApp number for pairing-code login, digits only with country code, no + or spaces (e.g. 2349037524605). Leave empty to log in by scanning a QR code instead.

SELF_URL.description: This service's own public URL (e.g. https://your-app.onrender.com). When set, the bot pings itself every 5 minutes to prevent free-tier hosts from spinning the service down after inactivity. Optional, but recommended on free-tier hosting.
